entries.en: Jenlyns has an invitation in his pocket and he is happy to see you.

entries.en: Jenlyns hands you an invitation to the Ul Cup, a prestigious fighting tournament to be held at the Coliseum. According to the Sultansworn captain, the tournament was founded by the first sultan of Ul'dah, and after generations of obscurity, Nanamo has decided to revive it. Gladdened by your intent to participate, Jenlyns instructs you to seek out the tournament registrar on the Royal Promenade.
entries.fr: Enchanté de vous revoir en pleine forme, Jenlyns vous a donné une invitation pour participer au tournoi commémoratif du sultanat qui est sur le point de débuter au Colisée d'Ul'dah. Dans un premier temps, rendez-vous auprès du réceptionniste du tournoi sur la promenade royale et remettez-lui l'invitation.

　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
ジェンリンスから、「ウル王杯闘技会」の招待状を受け取った。ロイヤル・プロムナードの「闘技会の受付人」に「」を渡し、大会への参加受付をしよう。

entries.en: Among your would-be opponents you see faces both new and old, and the affable adventurer that you are, you take the opportunity to greet each of them. With that settled, perhaps a quick visit to the Gladiators' Guild to speak with your old guildmaster is in order.
entries.fr: Vous avez parlé à certains de vos adversaires éventuels, et avez été surpris de revoir certaines têtes familières. À présent, allez saluer Mylla à la guilde des gladiateurs.

entries.en:
Welcoming you warmly, Mylla gives you an overview of tournament rules, shortly after which the opening ceremony commences. Making a royal appearance, Nanamo declares the Ul Cup revived and gives her blessing to all combatants. May Nald'thal give strength to your sword arm.

※The next paladin quest will be available from Mylla upon reaching level 63.

しかも今回の大会は、エオルゼアの中でも、
選りすぐりの剣客たちのみが参加を許された特別なもの。
半端な腕や覚悟では、勝ち抜くことはできないだろう。

entries.en: Generations ago, my ancestor, Sasagan Ul Sisigan, founded a tournament to celebrate the skill of our nation's finest swordsmen. One hundred years have passed since it was last held. By this declaration, I do hereby revive the Ul Cup!
entries.fr: Merci à tous d'être venus aussi nombreux. Si nous sommes réunis aujourd'hui, c'est pour remettre au goût du jour le grand tournoi que Sasagan Ul Sisigan, le premier sultan d'Ul'dah, a organisé il y a plus d'un siècle.
entries.ja:
わらわは、ここに宣言する。
初代ウルダハ王ササガンI世が創始したと伝わる、
「ウル王杯闘技会」を、100年ぶりに復古することを！

コロセウム財団を通じて、難民支援に投じられることも、
民の前で宣言するものである！
